description: During the 2026-04-23 vision walk the morning-vision-walk skill failed because it referenced prompt-manager team decision-accept — a subcommand the CLI does not expose, even though the API supports PATCH /teams/{id}/decisions/{decisionId}. Root-cause principle: every scenario CLI must be a thin fully-featured wrapper over the scenario API. Fix scope: (1) add decision-accept subcommand to prompt-manager (wraps the PATCH with selected + notes, auto-attaches human-actor header for approval-mode teams); (2) audit every prompt-manager API endpoint against the CLI and add any missing subcommands; (3) land a test / lint that fails CI if a new API handler is added without a matching CLI command. This is a P1 blocker for the morning vision walk skill — without it, the skill is broken for every future walker.
name: prompt-manager-cli-api-parity
title: Prompt-Manager CLI Must Be Thin Wrapper Over API (Decision-Accept And Systematic Audit)
